violations.text: The chlorine sanitizer concentration for the sanitizing cycle of the dishwasher was 0 parts per million (ppm). Chlorine sanitizing solutions must be between 50-100 ppm. Paper/plastic products are to be used until dishwasher is serviced and reaching proper sanitizing concentration. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

Small refrigerator at the bar was observed held at 45 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. TCS foods (juices) were relocated to properly functioning unit. No TCS foods are to be placed in this unit until it is maintaining a consistent temperature at/below 41 degrees F. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026
Spray bottles used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

Thermometers are lacking in the refrigeration unit(s). All cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer inside the unit that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the chlorine sanitizing solution for the dishwasher. Test strips must be obtained. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026
